reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
), numbered AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    SUM(new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
  FROM flagged
), sessions AS (
  -- one row per session
  SELECT account_id, user_id, session_no, MIN(event_ts) AS session_start, MAX(event_ts) AS session_end
  FROM numbered
  GROUP BY account_id, user_id, session_no
), breaks AS (
  -- one row per session
  SELECT account_id,
    epoch(LEAD(session_start) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY session_no)) - epoch(session_end) AS break_seconds
  FROM sessions
)
SELECT account_id, ROUND(AVG(break_seconds) / 3600, 2) AS avg_break_hours
FROM breaks
GROUP BY account_id

solver.query:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT account_id, user_id, event_ts,
         LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
), breaks AS (
  SELECT account_id, epoch(event_ts) - epoch(prev_ts) AS gap_s
  FROM e
  WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL AND event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
)
SELECT a.account_id, ROUND(AVG(b.gap_s) / 3600.0, 2) AS avg_break_hours
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM app_events) a
LEFT JOIN breaks b ON b.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_id
